_doc: Japan 'Entire History' video photo catalog for fetch-photos (2026-11-15). Each entry is searched on Wikimedia Commons, licence-checked (public domain, CC0, CC BY) and stored in photo-cache/. 'must' = title must contain one of these words; 'alt' = caption if nothing is found. Entries that print MISS: run List photo candidates, pin {id, file:'File:Exact Title.jpg'} and fetch again. Spot-checked on Commons 2026-11-15: jomon_pottery (CC-licensed flame-pot photos exist), daisen_kofun (government aerial, attribution), great_wave (PD), hiroshima_dome (many CC BY). Risk flags are folded into 'alt' per the Iran pattern; every flagged pin names its drawn fallback.
